title: Chapter 54 — Association Networking
intro: Which associations matter, the member-not-vendor posture, and converting rooms into pipeline.

sections.title: Be a Member — Not a Vendor
sections.content:
Trade associations — home builders, kitchen and bath designers, renovation contractors — are rooms where your prospects gather. Join as a contributor, not a salesperson.

Attend events. Serve on committees. Share expertise. Build genuine relationships. The pipeline comes from trust earned over time, not business cards exchanged at one event.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating networking, ask:

Is the salesperson active in relevant trade associations?
Are they contributing value — or just collecting contacts?
Are association relationships converting into business — or staying social?
